in_hebrew.name: Freeman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Freeman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘frēgan’, meaning ‘to free’. A name for someone who is free in mind and spirit. In Christian tradition, it can also represent a man who is freed by the grace of God.

in_greek.name: Freeman
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Free man
in_greek.long_meaning: Freeman είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ‘frēgan’, meaning ‘to free’. A name for someone who is free in mind and spirit. In Christian tradition, it can also represent a man who is freed by the grace of God.

in_latin.name: Freeman
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Free man
in_latin.long_meaning: Freeman est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English ‘frēgan’, meaning ‘to free’. A name for someone who is free in mind and spirit. In Christian tradition, it can also represent a man who is freed by the grace of God.
